answer: Deposits are visible in wharf, and nebula reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 44% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 148 aliases, and each one needs its own funded sonnet account. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 16 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
